Session 建立 | `connect` + `handshake` | 進入 `/ApiTokens` → CookieAuthenticationMiddleware 驗證 → 渲染或 redirect | | 2. 保活 | `ping/pong` | 每次 fetch / form submit 自帶 `Cookie: .AspNetCore.Cookies`；server 端 sliding expiration | | 3. 401 重導 | `reconnect` | AuthFetchInterceptor 偵測 401 → Toast → setTimeout 1.5s → `window.location.href = '/Login'` | | 4. 結束 | `close` | 使用者點擊「登出」→ `SignOutAsync` → `Set-Cookie: ...; Max-Age=0` | ## 安全規則（FRONTEND §6.2） - Cookie 必為 `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax`；前端 JS 無法讀取 - AntiForgery Token 由 Razor `@Html.AntiForgeryToken()` 注入 hidden input；fetch 透過 `X-CSRF-Token` Header 帶 - 401 攔截器設 1.5s 延遲讓 Toast 完成顯示 - Bearer Token（P06）僅存於 Alpine `x-data` memory；**禁止** localStorage / sessionStorage / Cookie
expected_html:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User (Browser)
    participant Razor as Razor Page (/ApiTokens)
    participant Fetch as AuthFetchInterceptor (Alpine)
    participant API as ASP.NET Core API
    participant ERPAuth as ERP Cookie Auth Middleware
    participant Toast as ToastSystem

    Note over U,ERPAuth: Phase 1 — Session 建立（≈ WS connect handshake）
    U->>Razor: GET /ApiTokens
    Razor->>ERPAuth: read .AspNetCore.Cookies (HttpOnly)
    alt Cookie 存在 + 有效
        ERPAuth-->>Razor: User.Identity = { userId, isSuperuser }
        Razor-->>U: 200 HTML + AntiForgery hidden input + Alpine x-data
    else Cookie 缺失/過期
        ERPAuth-->>Razor: redirect /Login?returnUrl=/ApiTokens
        Razor-->>U: 302 Found + Set-Cookie: clear
    end

    Note over U,ERPAuth: Phase 2 — Session 保活（≈ heartbeat / 每次 fetch 自帶 Cookie）
    U->>Fetch: 點擊 [建立 Token] → submit({ description })
    Fetch->>Fetch: read csrfToken from hidden input
    Fetch->>API: POST /api/v1/me/tokens<br/>Cookie: .AspNetCore.Cookies<br/>X-CSRF-Token: <token><br/>Idempotency-Key: <uuidv4><br/>Body: { description }
    API->>ERPAuth: validate cookie + AntiForgery
    alt Cookie 有效 + CSRF 有效
        ERPAuth-->>API: User.Identity 載入
        API-->>Fetch: 201 Created<br/>{ tokenId: UUID, tokenPrefix: String, rawToken: String, createdAt: DateTimeOffset }
        Fetch-->>Razor: redirect /ApiTokens/Created (TempData carries rawToken)
    else CSRF 失敗（419）
        ERPAuth-->>API: throw AntiforgeryValidationException
        API-->>Fetch: 419 Page Expired<br/>{ error: "CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID" }
        Fetch->>Toast: show("error", "請重新整理頁面後再試")
        Fetch-->>U: page reload prompt
    end

    Note over U,ERPAuth: Phase 3 — 401 攔截 + redirect（≈ WS reconnect）
    U->>Fetch: 點擊 [撤銷 Token] → confirm()
    Fetch->>API: DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}<br/>Cookie + X-CSRF-Token + Idempotency-Key
    API->>ERPAuth: validate cookie
    alt Cookie 過期（>2hr idle）
        ERPAuth-->>API: 401 Unauthorized
        API-->>Fetch: 401 { error: "SESSION_EXPIRED" }
        Fetch->>Toast: show("warning", "您的登入已過期，1.5 秒後將返回登入頁")
        Fetch->>Fetch: setTimeout(1500ms)
        Fetch-->>U: window.location.href = '/Login?returnUrl=' + currentPath
    else Token 不存在（404）
        API-->>Fetch: 404 Not Found<br/>{ error: "TOKEN_NOT_FOUND" }
        Fetch->>Toast: show("error", "Token 不存在或已撤銷")
    else 撤銷成功
        API-->>Fetch: 200 OK<br/>{ tokenId: UUID, status: "Revoked", revokedAt: DateTimeOffset }
        Fetch->>Toast: show("success", "Token 已撤銷")
        Fetch-->>U: refresh page (or update Alpine state)
    end

    Note over U,ERPAuth: Phase 4 — Session 結束（≈ WS close）
    U->>Razor: 主動點擊 ERP 主應用「登出」
    Razor->>ERPAuth: SignOutAsync(CookieAuthenticationDefaults.AuthenticationScheme)
    ERPAuth-->>Razor: Set-Cookie: .AspNetCore.Cookies=, Max-Age=0
    Razor-->>U: 302 Found → /Login
